name: Morinaga Milk Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Morinaga Milk Industry Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production and sale of various dairy products in Japan and internationally. The company offers milk products, including homogenized, sterilized whole, and enriched milk; beverages comprising milk-based, coffee, chilled tea, and various other beverages; Greek, fruit, and various other yogurt products; chilled desserts, such as baked, milk, and low carb pudding; and ice cream products. It also provides cheese and butter; infant formula and baby food products; milk powder, milk supplements, and bifidobacterium longum BB536 per capsule; liquid diet and nursing care food; and other products, including creaming powder…
